description: App store reviews from iOS and Android

data.title: Best PM tool I've used
data.body: Incredible analytics and the AI suggestions are actually useful. Docked nothing because it's that good, but PLEASE add dark mode. My only wish.

data.title: Crashes every time I switch projects
data.body: Was a 5-star app until the last update. Now it crashes every time I try to switch between projects. Lost work multiple times. Using the web version until this is fixed. Samsung Galaxy S24, Android 14.

data.title: Took me a week to figure out
data.body: The product is powerful once you understand it but the setup process assumes you already know what you're doing. Spent a week watching YouTube tutorials before I could actually use it productively. Documentation could be much better for beginners.

items.label: ★★★★☆ Love it, export is broken though

data.title: Almost perfect
data.body: Beautiful UI, great features, responsive team. But the CSV export hasn't worked properly for the past month. I need to generate reports for clients and have been manually copying data. Please fix this!

data.title: Game changer for remote teams
data.body: We switched from Competitor and the difference is night and day. The real-time collaboration features are years ahead. Our team productivity jumped noticeably in the first week. Worth every penny.

data.title: Not ready for enterprise
data.body: Great product for small teams but our 200-person org is struggling. No SSO that actually works, no SCIM, rate-limited API, can't bulk manage users. We're paying enterprise prices for startup-level admin tools.
